verdict.rationale: Radar surfaces data-driven insights inside the Dashboard. Risk insights show the risk factors behind Radar's scoring, including networks of related payments. Fraud Insights analytics identify combinations of attributes that drive fraud rates, and risk settings adjust thresholds automatically. None of this is explicitly framed as AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, so it only partly matches the story. Missing for 10: explicit AI/LLM-generated insight or recommendation features (e.g., suggested rules from your data), natural-language explanations, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
